title: Far Niente Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutFar Niente ~ 385 Western Lake Drive ~ WaterColor FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off thru June 26th! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed by a June 27th departure. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Late Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays starting July 11th and completed by August 9th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. Far Niente is a luxurious 3,242sf home located in the Park District of WaterColor sleeping up to 12 guests, with 5 bedrooms/5.5 baths and 2 living rooms. Bordering the nature preserve along Western Lake, Far Niente offers privacy and views of the lake and nature preserve from expansive porches. Access to WaterColor's community pools and Beach Club; $100 credit toward beach chair/umbrella rentals through WaterColor's Beach Club! Wristbands for access to resort amenities (required for all guests ages 5 years and older) await inside the home for your arrival. Main level: Open, vaulted entry hallway. Secondary living room, laundry room, 3 en-suite bedrooms, powder room, covered porch. #1 En-suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower #2 En-Suite Bedroom has a Queen bed, walk-in shower #3 En-Suite Bedroom has 2 sets of bunks (4Twins), walk-in shower Second Level: Main living room, dining table for 8-10, screened porch, fully equipped kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, balcony. Please note: fireplace is decorative only. #4 Bedroom has a Queen bed Full bath, with walk-in shower #5 En-Suite Bedroom (Master) has a King bed, separate tub, walk-in shower, walk-in closet Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured), built-in desk Entertainment Features 7 Flat Screen TVs, 3 Blu-Ray players, 2 DVD players, whole house stereo, board games, books Distinctive Features Western Lake and Nature Preserve Views Access to WaterColor's Beach Club, 4 community pools, tennis facilities $100 credit toward beach service set-ups (receipt must be emailed to us for credit to be applied) 7-minute walk to Beach Club 8-minute walk to Seaside Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 3 vehicles 2 King beds, 2 Queen beds, 2 Bunks (4 Twins) 2 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, iron, ironing board, 5 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor porches, porch furniture, outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, gas range, refrigerator with ice dispenser, separate ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, desk, pantry, washer, dryer. Area Features TimpoocheeTrail (30A bike path) Seaside (4/10th mile) Grayton Beach (1.5 mile) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
